A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same EM analysis for overspecified two-component mixed linear regression. The text, equations, five figures, and Appendices A–H support comparison, with no material reading gaps.

before.justification: Section 8 and Figures 1–4 report original simulations and numerical calculations of EM trajectories, dynamics, and convergence, including experiments with 2,000 Gaussian samples.

after.justification: v2 retains the original simulations and numerical convergence results in Section 8 and Figures 1–4.

M1.justification: The analyzed 2MLR model and population, finite-sample, and easy-EM update procedures are unchanged. The revised haplotype illustration does not alter the algorithm studied.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same synthetic overspecified Gaussian setting. Haplotype assembly, phase retrieval, overparameterization, and mixture-of-experts discussions do not introduce evaluated datasets or tasks.

E2.justification: The numerical comparisons retain the same EM updates, approximations, and theoretical bounds. Newly discussed phase-retrieval methods are compared through cited theory, not evaluated as experimental baselines.

E3.justification: Section 8 and figure captions retain the sample sizes, dimensions, initialization ranges, parameter sweeps, and iteration counts, including the 2,000-sample trajectory experiment and 200-iteration convergence illustrations.

E4.justification: The initialization sensitivity, approximate-dynamics checks, convergence-bound illustrations, and converged-weight analysis are retained. The added explanatory discussions introduce no new ablation, robustness test, or empirical case study.

E5.justification: The reported ten trajectory trials remain unchanged. Neither version adds experimental seed information, confidence intervals, significance tests, or a revised uncertainty-reporting procedure.

E6.justification: All five figures retain identical plotted content and captions, and Section 8 retains the same numerical findings. The added literature comparisons do not supply new experimental outcomes.

T1.justification: Appendix B.3 corrects the left-hand iteration indices from alpha^t and beta^t to alpha^(t+1) and beta^(t+1). Section 3.1 also replaces its illustrative Gaussian regression formulation with a vector mixture and explicit bit-flip probabilities. The principal theorems and remaining appendix derivations are unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction’s contribution statements, and conclusion retain the same claims about initialization-dependent convergence, finite-sample accuracy for fixed mixing weights, and the low-SNR extension.

C2.justification: v2 adds likelihood-curvature and Fisher-information explanations for the central convergence and accuracy regimes. It also qualifies the haplotype analogy through an explicit model/noise mismatch and substantially expands applicability interpretations through phase-retrieval rate comparisons and connections to overparameterization and mixture-of-experts models.

D1.justification: Section 8 newly supplies a repository URL for the numerical experiments. This adds code-access information, although repository contents and availability cannot be established from the PDFs alone.

R1.justification: Expanded Section 3.2 and new Sections 3.3–3.4 substantially broaden positioning through phase-retrieval comparisons and overparameterization/MoE literature, including Neykov et al., Xiong et al., and Fruytier et al. Chen’s changed citation year and duplicated Ho/Nguyen bibliography entries do not represent additional distinct works.

P1.justification: Rewriting is concentrated in the motivating examples, two new subsections, and intuitive explanations accompanying Theorems 5.1 and 6.1. The overall organization and most main-text and appendix prose remain unchanged.

P2.justification: v2 adds publication headers and revises the title-page affiliation layout. Existing figures shift with text reflow, but their graphics, axes, legends, and captions remain unchanged; no figure or table is added.

improvement.justification: The new theorem explanations, explicit haplotype-model qualification, code link, and Appendix B.3 correction provide useful gains. However, expanded Section 3.2 claims phase-retrieval advantages at nonzero SNR, including SNR approximately 1, using Theorem 6.1, which assumes zero signal and fixed mixing weights. The unchanged Appendix H supplies approximate dynamics rather than the missing finite-sample guarantee. These explanatory and reproducibility gains coexist with insufficiently supported applicability claims, leaving the net quality direction unclear.
